title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 7 — WORLD 1: B2 → C1 GATEWAY
description: Grade 7 begins the transition from strong B2 communication toward C1-level independence through precision vocabulary, complex grammar, extended reading, authentic listening, sustained speaking and structured writing.

targets.vocabulary: 2600+ active words and phrases with collocations, idioms, phrasal verbs and academic language
targets.reading: 1600–1900 words with inference, evaluation, synthesis and author stance
targets.listening: 16–20 minutes of authentic multi-speaker English with varied accents
targets.speaking: 20–25 minutes of sustained discussion, explanation, negotiation and presentation
targets.writing: 550–700 words across analytical, argumentative, formal and reflective tasks
targets.presentation: 10–12 minutes with evidence, structure and Q&A

grammar: advanced tense and aspect for precise meaning
modal verbs and modal perfects for deduction and stance
complex relative clauses and noun phrases

missions.title: Vocabulary Intelligence Lab
missions.focus: advanced collocations, word families, idioms and high-value academic vocabulary

missions.title: Tense & Aspect Precision
missions.focus: advanced control of time, aspect and narrative perspective

missions.title: Modal Meaning & Deduction
missions.focus: certainty, probability, deduction and nuanced speaker stance

missions.title: Conditional Reasoning
missions.focus: mixed conditionals, hypothetical situations and consequences

missions.title: Passive & Reporting Mastery
missions.focus: formal passive structures, reporting verbs and attribution

missions.title: Complex Sentence Builder
missions.focus: subordination, reduced clauses and concise complex expression

missions.title: Information Focus Lab
missions.focus: inversion, clefts, fronting and emphasis for precise communication

missions.title: Cohesion & Coherence Mission
missions.focus: logical organization, referencing, linking and discourse flow

missions.title: Register & Pragmatics
missions.focus: formal, neutral, informal and diplomatic language choices

missions.title: Advanced Conversation Arena
missions.focus: sustained discussion, follow-up questions, clarification and spontaneous response

missions.title: Reading Explorer — Hidden Meaning
missions.focus: long-form reading with inference, attitude, implication and author purpose

missions.title: Authentic Listening Lab
missions.focus: multi-speaker listening, implied meaning, attitude and note-taking

missions.title: Analytical Writing Lab
missions.focus: structured analysis with evidence, explanation and clear conclusions

missions.title: Formal Communication Mission
missions.focus: professional emails, reports, requests, complaints and recommendations

missions.title: Presentation & Q&A Lab
missions.focus: structured presentation, signposting, evidence and spontaneous questions

missions.title: Real-World Negotiation
missions.focus: negotiating solutions, clarifying interests and reaching agreement

missions.title: Media, Technology & Society
missions.focus: evaluating information and discussing technology and social impact

missions.title: Academic & Workplace English
missions.focus: meetings, project discussion, study skills and professional interaction

missions.title: World 1 Integrated Marathon
missions.focus: integrated vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking and writing

missions.title: WORLD 1 MASTER QUEST — B2 → C1 GATEWAY
missions.focus: capstone assessment combining independent communication, analysis, negotiation and presentation

assessment: listening comprehension of explicit and implied meaning
